descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S09 Custom template cannot be saved without a type (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Creating a custom template requires a note-type selection (one of the 8 pilot templates or 'Procedure / other'); the template cannot be saved without one (step 3). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92599 AC 8; TFA-92599 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Settings -> Note Templates -> New, in Hospital and in Nursing Home

When Fill name and instructions, leave the type empty, press Save Template; then close the form and look at the template list

Then Save is refused and the form stays open with a required-field message; no 'QA ... no-type' template appears in the list

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: after Save the form is still open (mustContain 'Template Name', known gap until AC 8) and shows no save error (mustNotContain 'Could not save template', which the form shows when the server rejects a save); after closing it the Settings template list mustNotContain the template's name. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
